description: This file sets up dependency injection functions for FastAPI, providing access to repositories and services related to users, videos, and history, with internal connection management.

classes.name: SQLiteConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages SQLite database connections, creating them on demand.

classes.name: SQLiteUserRepository
classes.description: Repository class for user-related database operations.

classes.name: SQLiteVideoRepository
classes.description: Repository class for video-related database operations.

classes.name: SQLiteHistoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class for history-related database operations.

classes.name: VideoService
classes.description: Service class handling video-related business logic.

classes.name: HistoryService
classes.description: Service class managing history-related business logic.

methods.name: get_user_repo()
methods.description: Provides a user repository instance with an active database connection.

methods.name: get_video_repo()
methods.description: Provides a video repository instance with an active database connection.

methods.name: get_history_repo()
methods.description: Provides a history repository instance with an active database connection.

methods.name: AuthService get_auth_service(user_repo=Depends(get_user_repo))
methods.description: Provides an AuthService instance, injecting the user repository.

methods.name: VideoService get_video_service(video_repo=Depends(get_video_repo))
methods.description: Provides a VideoService instance, injecting the video repository.

methods.name: HistoryService get_history_service(history_repo=Depends(get_history_repo))
methods.description: Provides a HistoryService instance, injecting the history repository.
